test_title: PYST 21: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The length and the breadth of the floor of a rectangular hall are 98 feet and 70 feet, respectively. If all persons in the hall are allotted equal square spaces as workstations, what will be the area of the largest such workstation that can be allotted to any user, assuming no space in the hall is left unoccupied?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the floor = 98 feet

Breadth of the floor = 70 feet

**Formula Used:**

Area of the largest square workstation = (GCD of Length and Breadth)²

**Calculation:**

Length = 98 feet

Breadth = 70 feet

GCD of 98 and 70:

98 = 2 × 7 × 7

70 = 2 × 5 × 7

GCD (98, 70) = 2 × 7 = 14

Area of the largest square workstation = 14²

Area = 196 sq. ft

**The area of the largest workstation that can be allotted to any user is 196 sq. ft.**
